findings.title: Optimized paginator cannot paginate audit-log datetimes
findings.body: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint uses this paginator with order_by="-datetime", so get_item_key receives a datetime, not a number. math.floor/math.ceil on that value raises TypeError when build_cursor processes any nonempty page, making optimized audit-log requests fail instead of returning logs. value_from_cursor also returns the raw numeric cursor rather than converting it to a datetime for the query. Use DateTimePaginator's key encoding and cursor decoding for this endpoint.

findings.title: Negative offsets are not supported by Django QuerySet slicing
findings.body: When advanced features are enabled and a cursor has a negative offset (for example, cursor=0:-1:0), this branch passes a negative slice start to a Django QuerySet. Django rejects negative indexing with ValueError; it does not handle the boundary automatically as the comment claims. Consequently, the explicitly advertised negative-offset feature fails before executing a query. Reject such cursors with a pagination error or implement reverse traversal using supported nonnegative slicing and query ordering.
